title: CIDER: A CAUSAL CURE FOR BRAND-OBSESSED TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image model generations using a proposed Brand-Neutrality Score (BNS) that quantifies bias severity. The BNS is calculated using an Explicit Brand Representation Detector (EBRD) for identifying logos and an Implicit Brand Aesthetics Detector (IBAD) using CLIP embedding similarities, evaluated on a custom dataset (BrandBench) alongside expert human evaluation.
